problem: Distribution switch uplink dropping VoIP traffic
symptoms: Choppy calls, packet drops on VLAN interfaces, elevated interface error counters
root_cause: Duplex mismatch on the uplink to the voice gateway causing retransmissions and drops
resolution:
show interface counters
confirm duplex settings on both ends
set uplink to matching full duplex
monitor error counters
verification: VoIP MOS scores return to baseline and interface errors stop incrementing

problem: Linux mediation service not responding to API requests
symptoms: API timeout alarms, connection refused errors, no process listening on the service port
root_cause: The mediation daemon crashed after a malformed configuration deployment
resolution:
systemctl status mediation.service
inspect journalctl logs
restore known good configuration
systemctl restart mediation.service
verification: Service shows active state and API health checks return HTTP 200

problem: Firewall policy blocking SFTP delivery to billing partner
symptoms: Transfer retries, denied flow logs, delayed CDR export completion
root_cause: New egress policy omitted the billing partner destination subnet and TCP port 22 exception
resolution:
review firewall hit counts
add destination subnet and service rule
commit policy
retry SFTP transfer
verification: File delivery succeeds and partner acknowledges receipt of the export
